user.title: Connect to Immich
user.description: Enter your Immich server details. Home Assistant will verify the connection before continuing.

source.title: Choose a photo source
source.description: Choose how this frame should select photos. Your other settings are kept when you change the source.

connection.title: Choose an Immich connection
connection.description: Reuse a saved server and API key, or connect to another server. The connection will be checked before continuing.

data_description.connection_id: Saved connections show the server URL and the name of a frame that uses it.

new_connection.title: Connect to another Immich server
new_connection.description: Enter the server URL and API key. These details will be available when you add more frames.

album.title: Choose an Immich album
album.description: Choose an album from your Immich server. Only photos in this album will be shown.

data_description.album_id: Search by album name. Albums with the same name also show their ID so you can tell them apart.
data_description.navigation: Choose a Back option to change an earlier selection, then press Submit. Your other settings are kept.

memories.title: Configure On This Day memories
memories.description: Set the date range used to find memories around today.

data.fallback_to_all: Fall back to All photos when memories are empty

data_description.memory_window_days: How many days before and after today to check when using On This Day memories.
data_description.fallback_to_all: Use the All photos source if Immich has no matching memories.
data_description.navigation: Choose a Back option to change an earlier selection, then press Submit. Your other settings are kept.

smart.title: Configure Smart Search
smart.description: Describe what Immich Smart Search should find.

data_description.smart_query: Enter a description such as “beach at sunset”.
data_description.navigation: Choose a Back option to change an earlier selection, then press Submit. Your other settings are kept.

display.title: Configure the display
display.description: Choose how this frame should present the selected photos. Select Save frame to finish, or go back to change the source or its settings.

data.original_aspect_ratio: Keep original aspect ratio for single photos

data_description.mode: Single image shows one photo at a time. Matching portrait pairs places two portrait photos from nearby dates side by side.
data_description.orientation: Only photos with the selected orientation are eligible. This filters the source photos; it does not set the output size and aspect ratio. Choose Any orientation to allow every orientation. Matching portrait pairs still require portrait photos.
data_description.pair_window_days: The maximum number of days between the two portrait photos in a pair.
data_description.pairs_only: Skip a slide unless a matching portrait companion is available.
data_description.navigation: Choose a Back option to change an earlier selection, then press Submit. Your other settings are kept.
data_description.screen_shape: Choose Landscape (16:10, 1280 × 800), Portrait (10:16, 800 × 1280), or Square (1:1, 720 × 720). Photos keep their proportions with black padding where needed. Single photos with Keep original aspect ratio enabled fit within these limits without padding. Portrait pairs remain side by side.
data_description.original_aspect_ratio: On: supply each single photo without added black bars, cropping or stretching, scaled down to fit within the selected output size. Image dimensions can change between photos. Also applies when no matching pair is available. Paired photos still use the selected output size and aspect ratio.

error.connection_unavailable: That saved connection is no longer available. Choose another connection or enter the server details again.
error.invalid_auth: Check the API key and its asset.read permission in Immich.
error.album_access_denied: Could not access albums. Check that your Immich API key is valid and has album.read permission, then choose Album to retry.
error.albums_unavailable: Could not load albums from Immich. Choose Album to retry, or select another photo source.
error.no_albums: No albums are available to this Immich account. Create or share an album in Immich, then choose Album to retry, or select All photos.
error.album_unavailable: That album is no longer available. Choose another album from the updated list.
error.album_required: Choose an album to continue, or select Back to photo source.
error.name_required: Enter a name for this frame.
error.name_in_use: Another frame on this server already uses this name. Choose a different name.

abort.already_configured: A frame with this name is already configured.
